original_question: What is the name of the condition associated with parastremmatic dwarfism that limits normal joint movement?

final_qi.question: What is the name of the condition associated with parastremmatic dwarfism that limits normal joint movement?
final_qi.long_answer: Parastremmatic dwarfism, a TRPV4-related skeletal dysplasia, is commonly accompanied by congenital joint contractures known as arthrogryposis. These fixed contractures stiffen and deform the joints, thereby restricting the normal range of motion.

final_answer.long_answer: Parastremmatic dwarfism is a rare TRPV4-related skeletal dysplasia characterized by severe bone deformities. A well-documented associated feature is arthrogryposis—multiple congenital joint contractures—which stiffen the joints and markedly restrict their normal range of motion.
